subject: COBOL compilation group
notes: kb/Work PB1086: Rule: 'Compilation of a program prototype definition or a function prototype definition generates information required for the external repository, as specified in 8.13, External repository.' (cite.py --check 10.6.3 -> OK §10.6.3 1)). §8.13: 'Whether the information is taken from a prototype or a definition, the information stored in the external repository about the signature of a program or a function is the same.' (OK §8.13); 'The implementor shall provide a mechanism that allows the user to specify whether to update the external repository when a compilation unit is compiled.' (OK §8.13); and '... whether to flag differences in prototypes and definitions in the compilation group from the information in the external repository.' (OK §8.13). WHAT THE CODE DOES: a prototype's signature (LINKAGE formals + RETURNING) is generated and consumed IN-GROUP only - BinderDriver.BuildProgramDetailsTable (programs, GR10 b)) and the user-function table (functions) - so a caller in the SAME compilation group gets the prototype's details (witnessed by conformance:cases/12.3.8-REPOSITORY/udf_prototype and PB894's goldens). That half is met. The other half is not: this implementation declares its external repository to be the run-unit program registry (BinderDriver.cs:913/945, PrototypeSignatures.cs:32, docs/INTERPROGRAM_DESIGN.md), and ProgramEmitter.cs:632 skips every prototype ('a prototype registers no runtime module - the separately-compiled definition does (§10.6.3 GR1)') - so compiling a prototype contributes NOTHING to that repository; the §10.6.3 GR1 citation there is used to justify the opposite of what GR1 says. PROBE proto_only.cob (PROGRAM-ID. CGPO IS PROTOTYPE. with LINKAGE A / PROCEDURE DIVISION USING A. / END PROGRAM CGPO.) compiles clean at 2023 and emits a module with no repository record; a later separately-compiled caller naming CGPO in its REPOSITORY therefore takes §12.3.8.4 GR10 c) with a NULL signature (PrototypeSignatures: 'An UNRESOLVED prototype conforms'), so no compile-time conformance check against that prototype is possible. Neither §8.13 mechanism (update / flag differences) exists: the CLI (--help) has no repository option and src has no repository store. Not owned by any kb/Work note (PB612/PB817/PB989 mention the external repository only as GR10 c)'s fallback). Verdict PARTIAL: in-group generation verified; generation for the external repository across compilations absent. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (prototype definitions and the external repository §8.13 are post-85) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/BinderDriver.cs#BuildProgramDetailsTable (BuildProgramDetailsTable is deleted by kb/Work PB989; GroupRepository.ProgramDetails is the in-group search)
